components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The rare brass action used for explicit final commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 46%, var(--surface)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The default low-noise command button used across rails and panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--control-bg-hover); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 46%, var(--surface)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Compact two-option selector for publish mode and theme choices.
components.css: .ds-segment { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-segment button { min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.25; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-segment button:hover { background: var(--control-bg-hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-segment button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 46%, var(--surface)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segment-active { border-color: var(--selection-stroke) !important; background: var(--surface) !important; color: var(--text) !important; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Scope Card
components.description: Left-rail scope selector with a small brass selected marker.
components.css: .ds-scope-card { position: relative; width: 260px; min-height: 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 5px 6px 5px 28px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); text-align: left; font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-scope-card:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 62%, transparent); } .ds-scope-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-point) 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-scope-card strong { font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-scope-card small { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.76rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-scope-dot { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 50%; width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rail-bg); transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-scope-active { background: var(--surface-active); } .ds-scope-active .ds-scope-dot { border-color: var(--accent-point); background: var(--accent-point); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-point) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Skill Row
components.description: Dense row pattern for skill entries and publish target actions.
components.html: impeccable文件夹
components.css: .ds-skill-row { min-height: 38px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, 1fr) 62px minmax(64px, auto); gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 4px 8px 4px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--line) 76%, transparent); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), border-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint); } .ds-skill-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface-muted) 62%, transparent); } .ds-skill-name { min-width: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-pill { width: fit-content; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tool { position: relative; width: 26px; height: 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), color var(--motion-base) var(--ease-out-quint), transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-tool:hover, .ds-tool.active { background: var(--control-bg-active); color: var(--text); } .ds-tool.active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 3px; bottom: 3px; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-point); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-point) 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Transient top-right status notice with semantic dot.
components.css: .ds-notice { max-width: 320px; min-height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px color-mix(in oklch, var(--shadow) 72%, transparent); color: var(--text); font-family: Geist, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.42; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-notice-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text-muted); transition: transform var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-notice:hover .ds-notice-dot { transform: scale(1.18); } .ds-notice button { width: 18px; height: 18px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 64%, transparent); font: inherit; line-height: 1; } .ds-notice button:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 8%, transparent); color: currentColor; } .ds-notice-success { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ok-text) 22%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ok-bg) 58%, var(--surface)); } .ds-notice-success .ds-notice-dot { background: var(--ok-text); }

narrative.overview:
SkillSym should feel like a precise desktop workbench: quiet enough to disappear, structured enough to make file state obvious, and restrained enough that users trust each action before they publish or remove anything. The system is a dense product UI, not a landing page, so clarity comes from columns, fine separators, subtle active states, and predictable controls.

The visual language is light by default because users are managing local folders in a daytime desktop workflow, often comparing paths and skill names in a normal IDE-adjacent environment. Dark mode exists for low-light use, but it keeps the same subdued hierarchy instead of becoming a separate dramatic theme.

The system explicitly rejects dirty greens, decorative gradients, visible texture, heavy shadows, crowded cards, and attention-seeking motion. Any new screen must preserve the current operating-room calm: text and file locations first, controls second, decoration last.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but readable desktop layout with a fixed rail and task-first content pane.
Restrained OKLCH palette: tinted neutrals plus a rare brass accent.
Low elevation by default, with shadows reserved for transient overlays and notices.
System-sans typography tuned for Chinese and English labels at compact sizes.
Motion communicates state changes only, using 140-240ms ease-out curves.

rules.name: The Rare Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is a state signal, not a brand wash. Keep it under 10% of any screen and never use it as background decoration.

rules.name: The Porcelain Neutral Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are always lightly tinted neutrals. Pure black and pure white are forbidden.

rules.name: The No Display Type Rule
rules.body: Labels, buttons, file paths, and data never use display fonts or decorative letter spacing.

rules.name: The Weight-Only Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is created with weight, color, and placement. Do not add oversized text inside compact panels.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Floating Rule
rules.body: Static panels, rows, cards, tabs, and buttons do not cast shadows. Only overlays and notices may lift.

dos: Do keep primary content first: skill names, scope paths, source location, publish mode, and target state must be faster to scan than surrounding controls.
Do use OKLCH tokens and color-mix() for hover, focus, and status blends.
Do keep controls compact: 5px radius, 20-30px height, and fixed icon button dimensions.
Do use fine separators, tonal panels, sticky headers, and scroll fades to define structure.
Do keep motion between 140ms and 240ms, using ease-out quart, quint, or expo curves.
Do preserve both light and dark theme token parity when adding new surfaces.
donts: Don't use dirty greens, decorative gradients, visible texture, heavy shadows, crowded cards, or attention-seeking motion.
Don't use pure black, pure white, glassmorphism, gradient text, or decorative color washes.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, rows, callouts, or alerts.
Don't add nested cards. Use full-width bands, separators, or table-like rows instead.
Don't make inactive states saturated. Accent color belongs to action, focus, selection, and status.
Don't animate layout properties or create page-load choreography. Product UI loads into the task.
